ChatGPT's share of AI-chatbot web traffic

ChatGPT's web traffic share fell from 76.4% one year ago to around 52.7% one month ago.

Gemini has taken the largest share of that ground, rising from roughly 9% to 27.3% over the same period.

Similarweb estimates monthly visits using a combination of direct measurement from opt-in devices and panels, ISP data, public data sources, and machine learning models.

Our methodology covers both desktop and mobile web.
